# Operator Note — Line Startup: Ring Rolling (SOP-P3-L2-01)

Purpose
- Provide a focused checklist for operators initiating the Ring Rolling line in accordance with SOP-P3-L2-01. Use this note to confirm readiness and to catch common startup issues.

Pre-start verification
- Confirm completed shift handover and review any outstanding flags in the logbook.
- Ensure machine guards, emergency stops, and safety interlocks are installed and functional.
- Verify tooling and mandrel assemblies match the production order and are secured per torque procedure.
- Confirm lubricant reservoirs, coolant flow paths, and filtration indicators show acceptable conditions.

Control system and instrumentation
- Power up the control cabinet and confirm the HMI boots to the operational screen.
- Validate feedback signals from position sensors and load cells; report any fault codes before proceeding.
- Check alarm history for latent faults that may immediately reappear on startup.

Material and feed
- Verify billet dimensions and material lot traceability are logged.
- Ensure feed conveyors and end stops are cleared and free of obstructions.
- Confirm heating process is at target state per heat control schedule before moving product to the roll area.

Initial roll sequence
- Perform a slow verification pass with an empty mandrel or dummy stock to confirm roll alignment and axis movement.
- Monitor bearings and drive systems for abnormal noise or vibration.
- Observe cooling flow and chip evacuation paths.

Communication and escalation
- Notify the line lead before introducing production material.
- If any anomaly is detected, stop the line, record the defect, and escalate per SOP-P3-L2-01.
- Log final startup confirmation and sign off in the shift record before handing over.
